headline.en: Query the right Google accounts in one call
headline.zh: 一次调用，查询所需的 Google 账户

sub.en: N-Bridge registers multiple Google accounts behind a local MCP server. Select one account or query every account that supports the requested Gmail, Calendar or Drive surface.
sub.zh: N-Bridge 将多个 Google 账户注册到本地 MCP 服务。可指定一个账户，也可查询所有支持相应 Gmail、Calendar 或 Drive 服务的账户。

body.en: An account_id selects one account; an omitted ID or * selects all eligible accounts.
body.zh: account_id 指定一个账户；省略或使用 * 时选择全部符合条件的账户。

body.en: Merged results remain grouped by account and service.
body.zh: 汇总结果仍按账户和服务标记。

title.zh: 分开保存 Token 与元数据

body.en: Refresh tokens go through an OS-keychain backend; account metadata is stored separately.
body.zh: 刷新 Token 通过系统钥匙串后端保存，账户元数据单独存储。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The shipped example calls the production selectAccounts function with complete synthetic account metadata. It shows routing decisions only; it does not simulate or claim successful Google queries.
note.zh: 随仓示例使用完整合成账户元数据调用实际 selectAccounts 函数，只展示路由决策，不模拟或宣称 Google 查询成功。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Production account selection on synthetic metadata, without OAuth, keychain or Google API access.

body.en: The shipped example calls the production selectAccounts function with complete synthetic account metadata. It shows routing decisions only; it does not simulate or claim successful Google queries.
body.zh: 随仓示例使用完整合成账户元数据调用实际 selectAccounts 函数，只展示路由决策，不模拟或宣称 Google 查询成功。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/n-bridge.git
cd n-bridge
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: The offline example verifies account selection only. OAuth consent, token refresh, keychain operation and live Google APIs require separate setup and verification.
limitations.zh: 离线示例仅验证账户选择。OAuth 授权、Token 刷新、钥匙串和在线 Google API 需要单独配置与验证。

limitations.en: fanout uses Promise.all, so one account error rejects that query rather than returning a partial-success report.
limitations.zh: fanout 使用 Promise.all，一个账户出错会使查询失败，不会生成部分成功报告。

limitations.en: The current list tools do not paginate through every result or provide write operations.
limitations.zh: 当前列表工具不会遍历全部分页，也不提供写操作。

body.en: When work and personal data live in separate accounts, a useful result needs both routing and attribution. N-Bridge selects eligible accounts before calling their APIs and keeps account_id on every returned group.
body.zh: 工作和个人数据位于不同账户时，查询既需要选对账户，也需要保留来源。N-Bridge 在调用 API 前选择符合条件的账户，并在每组返回值上保留 account_id。

body.en: OAuth consent populates the account registry and token store. The stdio MCP server exposes gmail.list, calendar.list and drive.list. selectAccounts filters by surface and optional ID; fanout invokes GoogleSurfaceClient concurrently and returns account-tagged results.
body.zh: OAuth 授权填充账户注册表和 Token 存储。stdio MCP 服务暴露 gmail.list、calendar.list、drive.list。selectAccounts 按服务和可选 ID 过滤账户，fanout 并发调用 GoogleSurfaceClient，返回带账户标记的结果。

body.en: OAuth consent populates the account registry and token store. The stdio MCP server exposes gmail.list, calendar.list and drive.list. selectAccounts filters by surface and optional ID; fanout invokes GoogleSurfaceClient concurrently and returns account-tagged results.
body.zh: OAuth 授权填充账户注册表和 Token 存储。stdio MCP 服务暴露 gmail.list、calendar.list、drive.list。selectAccounts 按服务和可选 ID 过滤账户，fanout 并发调用 GoogleSurfaceClient，返回带账户标记的结果。

body.en: The implemented tools list Google data using read-only scopes. Gmail returns message metadata and snippets, Calendar queries the primary calendar, and Drive lists selected file metadata. This local bridge does not provide Microsoft/Slack adapters or a hosted team account pool.
body.zh: 已实现工具使用只读权限列出 Google 数据。Gmail 返回邮件元数据和片段，Calendar 查询主日历，Drive 列出指定文件元数据。本地桥接器没有提供 Microsoft、Slack 适配器或托管团队账户池。

body.en: NBRIDGE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and NBRIDGE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET supply OAuth credentials. NBRIDGE_CALLBACK_PORT defaults to 8421; NBRIDGE_REDIRECT_URI defaults to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/cb and must match your registered redirect. ~/.nbridge/accounts.json contains profiles, supported surfaces and token references; keytar stores refresh tokens under the nbridge service. Tokens are used with Google for authentication, and queried data is returned to the connected MCP client.
body.zh: NBRIDGE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID 和 NBRIDGE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET 提供 OAuth 凭据。NBRIDGE_CALLBACK_PORT 默认 8421；NBRIDGE_REDIRECT_URI 默认 http://127.0.0.1:<port>/cb，必须与注册回调一致。~/.nbridge/accounts.json 保存资料、服务类型和 Token 引用，keytar 在 nbridge 服务下存储刷新 Token。Token 会用于 Google 认证，查询数据返回已连接的 MCP 客户端。

body.en: After setting your OAuth client variables, add opens browser consent for one account. Repeat it for other accounts. list displays mounted metadata; up serves MCP over stdio. Configure an MCP client to launch node with the absolute path to dist/index.js and argument up. Tools accept account_id, maxResults and q; q is used by Gmail and Drive, not Calendar.
body.zh: 设置 OAuth 客户端变量后，add 为一个账户打开浏览器授权，可重复添加其他账户。list 显示已注册元数据，up 通过 stdio 提供 MCP 服务。MCP 客户端应使用 node 启动 dist/index.js 的绝对路径并传入 up。工具接受 account_id、maxResults、q；q 用于 Gmail 和 Drive，不用于 Calendar。

details.code:
node dist/index.js add
node dist/index.js list
node dist/index.js up
